title: Overslam
summary: Overslam is a spell used to increase the power of a Seeker's charge, creating a blue aura in front of the user's body. The casting Seeker can then use this force to push someone or something like a magical battering ram, helping to clear the path. Overslam can also be used to save someone in a moment with a charging leap. This spell is used heavily by Lok Lambert.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Overslam was used by [[Lok Lambert]] to push [[Stack]] back in a fight with [[Wilder]]. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}} Lok later attempted to use it on Wilder but disrupted by Wilder's [[Weakenshade]] power. {{source|Knight of the Willblade}}

[[Wind]] used the spell to smash straight through a [[Scramjet]], sending it crashing to the ground. {{source|Dante's Return}}
